title: Interpersonal Attraction & Relationships
summary: Interpersonal attraction: factors influencing attraction (proximity, similarity, reciprocity, physical attractiveness) and relationship formation.
objectives: Explain the role of proximity, similarity, reciprocity and attractiveness.
revision: Interpersonal attraction: definition and factors (proximity, similarity, reciprocity, physical attractiveness).
traps: Attraction factors: proximity, similarity, reciprocity, physical attractiveness.
Mere exposure: repeated exposure increases liking.

notes.t: The positive evaluation of and desire to approach another person, forming the basis of relationships.

i: Proximity: physical closeness increases attraction (mere exposure)
Similarity: shared attitudes, values and backgrounds attract
Reciprocity: liking those who like us
Physical attractiveness: initial attraction influenced by appearance

notes.t: These factors operate in initial attraction; long-term relationships additionally depend on intimacy, commitment and satisfaction.
UGC NET frequently asks about factors influencing interpersonal attraction.

mnemonics.title: PSRP
mnemonics.text: P — Proximity (closeness, mere exposure), S — Similarity (shared attitudes/values), R — Reciprocity (liking those who like us), P — Physical attractiveness

flashcards.a: Positive evaluation and desire to approach another person.
